results.title: Gay Bars in Berlin: The Complete 2026 Guide
results.text:
Berlin has one of the largest queer scenes in Europe. Most bars cluster around Motzstraße in Schöneberg and in Neukölln.

Rainbow Corner Bar - Motzstraße 12, 10777 Berlin. Open Mon-Thu 20:00-03:00, Fri-Sun until late. Drag show every Saturday at 23:00.
